steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Paper 1 is worth 50% of the GCSE and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes | Key Fact: It covers both Greek and Roman mythology and religion — comparison between cultures is essential | Key Fact: The paper tests knowledge of myths, religious practices, temples, festivals and beliefs about death | Key Fact: Visual source analysis is central — you must discuss vase paintings, sculpture and architecture

steps.title: Lesson 4: Exam Practice

steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from paper 1: myth &amp; religion technique, and one past-paper question.
